title: Your organization
summary: Tell us about your organization once. Every step uses it to tailor your documents.

title: Purpose and promises
summary: Write a statement of what the program is for, and what it is not, before anything else.

title: Build your baseline together
summary: A conversation guide for HR, IT and employees to agree on an honest baseline, and soon a personal learning plan each employee owns.

title: Your AI learning plan
summary: A personal plan for your role, about 20 minutes a week. It stays on your device.

title: Learn and practise
summary: The shared core of AI literacy, and a safe sandbox for practising prompts with made-up data.

title: Fund it
summary: Find training grants that fit your organization, starting with B.C. and Canada.

title: Keep it going
summary: Office hours, champions, and a 90-day re-check everyone can see.

title: Document generator
summary: Generate the documents your rollout needs from your company profile.
